verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs show Function regions can be set per project in the dashboard, in vercel.json via the `regions` key, or via the CLI, and overridden per function. Enterprise users also get `functionFailoverRegions`, and Blob stores can be placed in a chosen region. This directly delivers deploying compute to regions closer to users. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of the available region inventory or automatic latency-based placement in the evidence.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy my application to specific regions closer to my users

citations.quote: You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
Enterprise users can also use functionFailoverRegions to specify regions that a Vercel Function should failover to if the default region is out of service.
Each store lives in one region that you choose, and Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
